title: FIFA 23
description: EA Sports FIFA 23, developed by EA Vancouver and EA Romania alongside EA Sports and published for Windows on September 30, 2022, is a 55 GB football sports simulation video game that utilizes upgraded HyperMotion2 technology captured from real-world match data to deliver smoother, more lifelike player movement across over 6,000 true-to-life animations. The gameplay shines with enhanced ball physics, refined dribbling and shooting mechanics, cross-play support, and deep, immersive modes like Ultimate Team and Career, making every match feel exceptionally authentic and tactically rich.

Processor: Intel Core i5 6600k or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
RAM: 8 GB
Hard Disk: 100 GB available space

installGuide:
Extract the file using Winrar. (Download Winrar)
Open “FIFA 23” folder, double click on “Setup” and install it.
After installation complete, go to the folder where you extract the game.

Then double click on “Game” icon to play the game. Done!
